output.summary: The zero-deviation record is almost certainly a reporting artifact. The bonus penalty (E3) began Feb 2026, and deviations fell from about 14 a month to 0 (E2). Meanwhile customer complaints, QC lot rejections, purchases of replacement components and adhesive, and survey fear of speaking up all rose (E10-E12, E16). Line 3's apparent 118% comes from unrecorded borrowed technicians, with unchanged per-technician productivity (E13). Line 3 also drives luer-leak complaints (E11). It is not a template. Prefer removing the penalty with non-retaliation and amnesty, plus an independent investigation, including shipped-lot risk. Do not roll out Line 3 practices, punish the supervisor yet, or unmask the reporter. Who directed the lending remains unknown.
